welcome.title: Welcome to {appName}
welcome.body:
{appName} is a free workspace for **game design documents**.

:::callout idea
Type `/` anywhere to insert headings, to-dos, toggles, callouts, tables and more.
:::

## Try it

- [ ] Write your game's one-sentence pitch
- [ ] List three design pillars
- [ ] Describe the core loop

:::toggle Where is my work stored?
In local mode everything stays in this browser (IndexedDB). Later you can connect a GitHub repository so your team can work on the same GDD.
:::

github.repoHint: Stored in this GitHub repository. Opens on github.com.
github.connectDescription: Your pages become Markdown files in a repository you own. Everyone you add to the repo can open the workspace.
github.openDescription: Pick a repository that already contains a workspace.
github.unconfigured: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server.
github.unconfiguredHint: Whoever runs this server needs to create a GitHub App and set its keys (see docs/GITHUB-SETUP.md). Local mode keeps working meanwhile.

errors.hasWorkspace: This repository already contains a workspace. Use “Open from GitHub” instead.
errors.notWorkspace: This repository has no workspace yet. Use “Save to GitHub” from a local workspace instead.
errors.offline: You're offline. Your work is saved in this browser; try again when you're back online.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again after {time}.
errors.signedOut: Your GitHub session expired. Sign in again; nothing local is lost.
errors.noAccess: The app can't access this repository. Check that it's installed on it and that you can push.
errors.generic: Something went wrong talking to GitHub. Your local work is safe.

share.title: Share with your team
share.description: Team access is GitHub access: whoever can push to the repository can edit the workspace.
share.step1: Add teammates as collaborators on the repository:
share.step2: They accept the invitation on GitHub.
share.step3: They open {app} and choose “Open from GitHub”, then {repo}.
share.permissions: Read access lets people view; write access lets them edit. Per-page permissions aren't possible on a Git repository.
share.manageInstall: Manage which repositories the app can access
share.localOnly: This workspace is only in this browser. Save it to GitHub first to share it.
